title: Zero IMX
summary: Photo network for CardputerZero: shoot, edit, post, follow and message.
description:
Zero IMX is a photo-sharing app made only for the CardputerZero. Every photo on it was taken with the device's own IMX219 camera.

- Camera: a fast viewfinder with a timer, then an editor with brightness, contrast, colour, warmth and ready-made looks (cyberpunk, landscape, portrait, night, mono, vintage, vivid).
- Feed: flip through photos with left and right, open the details, like, comment, zoom.
- People: search, follow, and see only the people you follow if you want.
- Messages: private messages with people who follow you. Block and report are built in.
- Codes: show your own QR code to add a friend, or scan one. Scan the code on the website to sign in there without typing a key.
- Badges and name colours, including badges for Kickstarter units.

There is also a website for looking at the feed from a phone or PC. Posting is only possible from a CardputerZero.

Zero IMX is run by one person as a hobby project. Photos are checked against the rules in the app, and anything reported is reviewed. The app needs a network connection and uses curl.
